description: This file defines the PHP class 'BuzzFeedPost' within the OrangeHRM system, representing a social media post in the Buzz module. It encapsulates properties and methods related to posts, shares, associated employee data, and post media details.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPost
classes.description: Represents a social media post and its associated data such as employee info, share details, media, and permissions within the OrangeHRM Buzz module.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the share post.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the post or share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of post (video, photo, or text).

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns statistics such as number of likes, comments, and shares.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time in H:i format.

methods.name: getOriginalPost
methods.description: Provides details of the original post if it is a share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns information about the employee associated with the post.

methods.name: isLiked
methods.description: Indicates whether the post is liked by the current user.

methods.name: getVideoLink
methods.description: Returns the video link associated with the post, if any.

methods.name: getPhotoIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of photos attached to the post.

methods.name: hasPhotos
methods.description: Checks if the post contains photos.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: Checks if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns the permissions for updating or deleting the post.
